note: Reviewed approval manifest (app/analytics/model_registry.py). Paths are relative to INDEPENDENT_MODEL_DIR (data/models). Read by research tooling only; the hosted app never reads it, and the projection switch reads projection_source.MODEL_VERSION, which must name the production model here, and serves an ifp-1.0.0 fallback run only when its artifact_id equals projection_source.FALLBACK_ARTIFACT_SHA256, which must equal the ifp-1.0.0 pin here (tested). Changing production is a separate, explicitly approved change to this file AND the consumer wiring (docs/independent_projection_engine.md, 'Model registry and promotion').

approval.note: The model the opt-in projection switch already read when the registry was created. Not an owner approval: it authorizes nothing new and cannot be reused by any other model.

models.reason: Previous production model: ridge conditional model with the ipm-1.0.0 participation artifact for expected points. Its artifact, training cutoff and held-out report are pinned (see pin): the file's sha256 equals the artifact_id the newest stored ifp-1.0.0 production run recorded, and projection_source.FALLBACK_ARTIFACT_SHA256 serves only runs of exactly these bytes. The participation artifact is not registered or pinned.

approval.reason: Owner decision ("upgrade it, and replace the ours"): the projection switch reads ifp-2.1.0, ifp-2.0.0 plus the injury workload handoff (iwh-0.1.1) and the empirical return-rate P(plays) for players Out/Doubtful at the rest-of-season cutoff for the team's next two games (ros-avail-0.1.1). Recorded as an owner override: the handoff's pre-registered research verdict was retain_baseline (failed the returning-player mechanism check c7, diagnosed and fixed in iwh-0.1.1), the return-rate P(plays) overrides ros-avail-0.1.0's retain_current verdict (0.1.1 is a prospective-only candidate, docs/research/ros_availability.md), SHADOW_PROMOTION_CRITERIA and PROMOTION_CRITERIA are not met, and no prospective or held-out report is cited. ifp-2.0.0 stays the rollback target and the fallback for a week without an ifp-2.1.0 run.

models.reason: Production since the owner approval above. Weekly-retrained like ifp-2.0.0 (injury_model.py, weekly_learning.train_production): each week's run (backtest_independent_projections.py project) uses the newest content-addressed ifp-2.1.0 artifact for that target week, trained on games before it, and records its file sha256 as the run's artifact_id (approved in approved_artifacts), so artifact.path and sha256 stay null here. Research evidence (historical, 2023-24 confirmation of the handoff features): pooled MAE -0.039 [-0.048, -0.031] vs ifp-2 on RB/WR/TE, every position better; rest-of-season P(plays) Brier for players Out/Doubtful at the cutoff 0.514 -> 0.239.

retired.reason: Replaced by ifp-2.2.0 (owner decision). Still read by the projection switch for a week without an ifp-2.2.0 run, and the rollback target.

approval.reason: Owner decision ("Force-promote shadows now: owner-override the prospective shadows into Ours today without waiting for evidence"): the projection switch reads ifp-2.2.0, ifp-2.1.0 plus the frozen specs of the research shadows ifp-ctx-p2q (QB start probabilities and the two-scenario mixture), ifp-ctx-p1 (QB and teammate context for RB/WR), ifp-dct-p1 (pregame depth tier, QB/RB/WR) and ifp-awd-p1 (decline-only role, RB/WR/TE). Recorded as an owner override: every shadow's pre-registered prospective gate (>= 8 fully final weeks from 2026 week 7, >= 400 matched appearances) is unmet, ifp-ctx-p1's and ifp-ctx-p2's historical verdicts were retain_baseline, SHADOW_PROMOTION_CRITERIA and PROMOTION_CRITERIA are not met, and no prospective or held-out report is cited. ipm-cal-0.1.0 (the QB P(plays) map) was left out by the backtest guard and ifp-fr-p1 (FTN first reads) is excluded pending the owner's licensing decision. The shadows' prospective ledgers keep running unchanged as the post-hoc evidence. ifp-2.1.0 stays the rollback target and the fallback for a week without an ifp-2.2.0 run.

models.reason: Production since the owner approval above. Weekly-retrained like ifp-2.1.0 (context_model.py, weekly_learning.train_context): each week's run (backtest_independent_projections.py project) uses the newest content-addressed ifp-2.2.0 artifact for that target week, trained on games before it, and records its file sha256 as the run's artifact_id (approved in approved_artifacts), so artifact.path and sha256 stay null here. Backtest guard (scripts/ifp22_backtest.py, 2023 - 2026 week 6, identical player-weeks, week-clustered 95% CIs, ifp-2.2.0 minus ifp-2.1.0 conditional MAE): QB -0.367 [-0.444, -0.276], RB -0.025 [-0.051, -0.003], WR -0.030 [-0.043, -0.018], TE +0.000 [-0.002, +0.002]; no points component's leave-one-out CI lies above 0. The QB P(plays) map raised unconditional QB MAE by +0.016 [+0.003, +0.031] and was left out.
Research-only gradient-boosting challenger (docs/research/hgb_challenger.md): worse than ifp-2 on development, ridge retained. Historical research cannot replace prospective confirmation.
